title: joints and their Jacobians on homogeneous transformations
author: Claude-JG
description: The constraint equations of the joints become functions of the relative transformation H0^-1 H1 of the two marker frames, and their Jacobians follow systematically from the relative twist - one implementation for JointGeneric, JointRevoluteZ, JointPrismaticX, the 2D joints and the rolling disc instead of one each. Successor of #2745 (the marker interface of RG14.2). revision2026b step RG14.3
releaseNotes: ObjectJointGeneric, ObjectJointRevoluteZ and ObjectJointPrismaticX compute their equations with one implementation on the relative frame of their joint frames, with analytic derivatives instead of automatic differentiation; the velocity level is their derivative times the velocities of the markers. Their reaction forces take half the time, a chain of revolute joints with modified Newton about 20 % less in all; the velocity level of the alternative constraints of ObjectJointGeneric is now the time derivative of these constraints.
